name: Triage
summary: You are asked to save wounded soldiers with Triage Bandages. Their injuries leave little room for delay.

sections.title: The Wounded
sections.body: Critically Injured Soldiers succumb first, while Badly Injured Soldiers follow. Injured Soldiers endure the longest, so the order of care matters as you try to save fifteen patients before six die from their wounds.

faq.q: What am I being asked to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to use Triage Bandages to save fifteen patients before six die from their injuries.

faq.q: Which soldiers are in the worst shape?
faq.answer: Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest, followed by Badly Injured Soldiers.
Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be tended after the more critically wounded.
Triage Bandages are used to tend to the soldiers' wounds.
